lines: The king said: "Bring him to me."
But when the messenger came, Yusuf would not leave. "Go back to your master, and ask him about the women who cut their hands."
He wanted his name cleared before he walked out.
The king questioned the women. And the wife of al-Aziz confessed: "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and he is of the truthful."
The king said: "Bring him to me." And when he spoke with him: "Today you are established with us, and trusted."
Yusuf said: "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."
From the bottom of a well... to a slave... to a prisoner... to the man in charge of the food of Egypt.
We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
The famine came, just as he had said. And it reached far beyond Egypt... all the way to his father's land.
